parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: RagWorkspaceCollection
parameters.description:
The vector dataset parameters.
> If WorkspaceId is not empty, this parameter is required.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: RunType
parameters.description:
The run type. Valid values:
- synchronous: synchronous execution.
- asynchronous: asynchronous execution. Currently not supported.

parameters.name: SecretArn
parameters.description:
The access credential. Created by calling the CreateSecret operation.

> When you access this operation by using a RAM user, you must have the UseSecret or GetSecretValue permission on this SecretArn.

parameters.name: Sqls
parameters.description: The list of multiple SQL statements.

parameters.name: StatementName
parameters.description: The name of the execution statement. This parameter takes effect only when RunType is set to asynchronous.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple database instances. This parameter and DBInstanceId cannot both be empty. If both this parameter and DBInstanceId are specified, this parameter takes precedence.
